context: Hiroshi has his last formal meeting with Kenji.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 健次、今日、最後の会議、本当に。
lines.en: Kenji — today, that last meeting. It really was something.
lines.style: Measured and steady opening. The weight of finality in the pause after the name. Quiet authority, no theatrics. A man reflecting on something that mattered.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 寂しい、けど、感謝、本当に。
lines.style: Soft and genuine throughout. Each phrase given its own small breath. Warmth without performance. The sincerity of someone who doesn't say things lightly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お前、本当、頼もしい、社長だ。
lines.en: You've become a reliable president. I mean that.
lines.style: Affirmation landing clearly, not as praise but as simple fact. Firm eye-contact level. The tenderness underneath authority — saying what he actually means, not what's expected.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: It's because of you, sir. All of it.
lines.style: Humble without self-diminishment. The gratitude is real and runs deep. Quieter than before — not defensive, just sincere.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 一緒に、ここまで、来た、宝。
lines.en: What we built together — that's precious to me.
lines.style: Each phrase deliberate and spaced. The word 「宝」 lands with quiet weight. Not sentimental, but philosophical. A man saying what he actually values.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Meeting you changed my life. You know that.
lines.style: Soft conviction underneath. Not rushed. Each word carries the sincerity of a realization he's had time to sit with. Tender without strain.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: I'll be rooting for you. From here on out.
lines.style: A promise, not a closing. Steady and unbroken. The firmness of someone who means what he says and will back it with action, not just words.
